correctness.rationale: For fixed n>=2 and positive finite r, mean-zero roots preserve the monic and constant coefficients; discrete Fourier Parseval and rotational orthogonality reduce the real second variation to a scalar beta-integral identity for r>1. A moving-simple-zero coordinate transformation makes the integral and its first two perturbation derivatives holomorphic in r on Re r>-1; the identity theorem legitimately extends the exact Hessian to 0<r<=1. Mahler measure is constant at r=0. Multivariate polarization and C2 give uniform little-o in finite dimensions. Packaged executable numerical diagnostic reports CHECK_OK, not used as infinite proof.
